note: 主题翻译：给一句中文，写英文，再对照。hint 用 / 分隔 2-3 个关键词，why 只讲搭配和介词。词汇和句式都控制在能稳定复现的难度。

sentences.zh: 塑料污染是一个越来越严重的问题。
sentences.en: Plastic pollution is a growing problem.
sentences.why: a growing problem 比 more and more serious 简洁，形容问题恶化时这是最常见的形式。

sentences.zh: 一次性袋子只用几分钟，却要几百年才能分解。
sentences.hint: 一次性 / 分解 / break down
sentences.en: A single-use bag is used for a few minutes but takes centuries to break down.
sentences.why: break down 是「分解」的常用说法；take + 时间 + to do 表示「需要多久才能做完」。

sentences.zh: 大部分塑料袋来自石油，而石油是有限的资源。
sentences.en: Most plastic bags are made from oil, which is a limited resource.
sentences.why: be made from 用于看不出原形的原料（塑料来自石油）；be made of 用于还能看出材质的东西。

sentences.zh: 这些袋子最后流进了海洋。
sentences.hint: 最后流进 / end up in
sentences.en: These bags end up in the ocean.
sentences.why: end up in 表示「最终落到某个（往往不好的）地方」，比 finally go to 自然得多。

sentences.zh: 海洋动物会误食塑料碎片。
sentences.en: Marine animals eat plastic pieces by mistake.
sentences.why: by mistake 放句末；也可以说 mistake plastic for food，介词用 for。

sentences.zh: 每个人都能少用一点。
sentences.hint: 少用一点 / a little less
sentences.en: Everyone can use a little less.
sentences.why: less 修饰不可数名词；a little less 比 use fewer 更适合泛指「用量少一点」。

sentences.zh: 政府应该让回收变得更容易。
sentences.en: The government should make recycling easier.
sentences.why: make + 宾语 + 形容词，easier 是形容词比较级，不能写成 more easy。

sentences.zh: 收费比直接禁止更容易执行。
sentences.en: A charge is easier to enforce than a ban.
sentences.why: enforce a rule / a ban 是固定搭配；easier to do 后面接动词原形。

sentences.zh: 这张图显示了二十年间上网人数的比例。
sentences.en: The chart shows the proportion of people with internet access over a twenty-year period.
sentences.why: the proportion of + 名词；over a period 表示「在一段时间内」，不用 in。

sentences.zh: 1990 年，这个数字不到百分之十。
sentences.en: In 1990, the figure was under ten percent.
sentences.why: 描述数据用 the figure 代替 the number，避免一段里重复 number。

sentences.zh: 之后它稳步上升。
sentences.en: After that, it rose steadily.
sentences.why: steadily 修饰上升的方式，比 quickly 更准确；rise 是不及物动词，后面不接宾语。

sentences.zh: 到 2010 年，它已经翻了一倍。
sentences.en: By 2010, it had doubled.
sentences.why: by + 过去时间表示「到那时为止」，主句用过去完成时 had done。

sentences.zh: 国家 A 一直是最高的。
sentences.en: Country A remained the highest throughout.
sentences.why: remain + 形容词表示保持某种状态；throughout 放句末，表示整段时间都是如此。

sentences.zh: 国家 B 的数字一直紧随其后。
sentences.en: The figure for Country B followed closely behind.
sentences.why: the figure for + 国家；follow closely behind 是固定说法，closely 不能换成 close。

sentences.zh: 两组数字之间的差距逐渐缩小。
sentences.en: The gap between the two groups narrowed gradually.
sentences.why: the gap between A and B；narrow 可以作动词，表示「缩小」。

sentences.zh: 总体来看，增长最明显的是年轻人。
sentences.en: Overall, the clearest growth was among young people.
sentences.why: Task 1 结尾常用 Overall 开头；among + 群体，表示「在……之中」。

sentences.zh: 越来越多的人在家工作。
sentences.hint: 在家工作 / work from home
sentences.en: More and more people work from home.
sentences.why: work from home 的 home 前不加 the；work at home 也可以，但远程办公更常说 from。

sentences.zh: 通勤时间被省下来了。
sentences.en: Commuting time is saved.
sentences.why: commuting 作名词指通勤这件事；这里用被动 is saved，因为重点是时间被省下。

sentences.zh: 员工可以更灵活地安排自己的一天。
sentences.en: Employees can organise their day more flexibly.
sentences.why: 修饰动词 organise 要用副词 flexibly；flexible 只能修饰名词。

sentences.zh: 但在家很容易分心。
sentences.en: But it is easy to get distracted at home.
sentences.why: get + 过去分词表示状态变化；被什么分心用 distracted by。

sentences.zh: 同事之间的交流变少了。
sentences.en: Communication between colleagues becomes less frequent.
sentences.why: between 用于双方之间；less frequent 修饰频率，不能说 less frequently 修饰 becomes。

sentences.zh: 有些工作必须在办公室完成。
sentences.hint: 必须 / have to be done
sentences.en: Some jobs have to be done in the office.
sentences.why: have to be done 是被动结构，表示「必须被完成」，主语是工作不是人。

sentences.zh: 公司可以两种方式都试。
sentences.en: Companies can try both ways.
sentences.why: both 后面接复数名词；try both ways 比 try the two methods 更简洁。

sentences.zh: 关键是工作有没有做完，而不是坐在哪里。
sentences.en: What matters is getting the work done, not where you sit.
sentences.why: What matters is + 动名词，是主语从句结构；get sth done 表示「把某事做完」。

sentences.zh: 很多学生毕业后找不到工作。
sentences.en: Many students cannot find a job after graduation.
sentences.why: after graduation 前不加 the；find a job 用不定冠词，指「一份工作」。

sentences.zh: 学校应该教实用的技能。
sentences.en: Schools should teach practical skills.
sentences.why: practical skills 是常见搭配，比 useful skills 更具体；skill 可数，这里用复数泛指。

sentences.zh: 小组作业能让学生学会合作。
sentences.en: Group work teaches students to cooperate.
sentences.why: teach sb to do；cooperate 后面接 with sb，不能直接加人。

sentences.zh: 父母的影响和老师一样重要。
sentences.hint: 一样重要 / as much as
sentences.en: Parents matter as much as teachers.
sentences.why: as much as 用于比较重要性；matter 作动词表示「重要」，比 are important 更口语自然。

sentences.zh: 大学教育不应该只看分数。
sentences.en: University education should not be judged by grades alone.
sentences.why: be judged by 表示「按……来评判」；alone 放句末表示「仅仅」。

sentences.zh: 有些课程在网上学更方便。
sentences.en: Some courses are easier to take online.
sentences.why: easier to take 后面接动词原形；online 在这里作副词，不加 on。

sentences.zh: 学生需要时间培养自己的兴趣。
sentences.en: Students need time to develop their own interests.
sentences.why: develop an interest 是固定搭配，不用 grow；interest 表示兴趣时可数。

sentences.zh: 好的老师能把难的内容讲简单。
sentences.en: A good teacher can make difficult content simple.
sentences.why: make sth + 形容词，simple 与 difficult 形成对照，不需要 more。

sentences.zh: 广告让人想买自己并不需要的东西。
sentences.en: Advertising makes people want things they do not need.
sentences.why: make sb do 不加 to；things they do not need 是省略了 that 的定语从句。

sentences.zh: 小公司很难和大品牌竞争。
sentences.en: Small companies find it hard to compete with big brands.
sentences.why: compete with 后面接对手；find it hard to do 中 it 是形式宾语，真正的宾语是 to do。

sentences.zh: 价格是顾客最在意的因素。
sentences.en: Price is the factor customers care about most.
sentences.why: care about 表示「在意」；most 放句末修饰 care about。

sentences.zh: 网上购物改变了人们的习惯。
sentences.en: Online shopping has changed people's habits.
sentences.why: 现在完成时强调影响延续到现在，比 changed 更贴合「至今仍在影响」。

sentences.zh: 好的服务能让顾客一再回来。
sentences.en: Good service keeps customers coming back.
sentences.why: keep sb doing 表示让某人持续做某事；coming back 是现在分词。

sentences.zh: 公司应该对自己的产品诚实。
sentences.en: Companies should be honest about their products.
sentences.why: be honest about sth，介词用 about，不用 to 或 with。

sentences.zh: 便宜不一定意味着质量差。
sentences.en: Cheap does not necessarily mean poor quality.
sentences.why: not necessarily 表示「不一定」，比 maybe not 更书面；poor quality 前不加 a。

sentences.zh: 一个品牌的名声要很多年才能建立。
sentences.en: A brand's reputation takes years to build.
sentences.why: reputation 可数，常与 for 连用；take years to do 表示「需要多年才能做到」。

sentences.zh: 政府可以先用收费代替禁止。
sentences.en: The government can use a charge instead of a ban at first.
sentences.why: instead of 后面接名词或动名词，不能接从句；at first 表示「起初」。

sentences.zh: 这项政策对低收入家庭影响最大。
sentences.en: The policy affects low-income families most.
sentences.why: affect 是及物动词，后面直接接宾语，不加 on；effect 才是名词。

sentences.zh: 短期内成本会上升。
sentences.hint: 短期内 / in the short term
sentences.en: Costs will rise in the short term.
sentences.why: in the short term 是固定短语，term 前必须加 the。

sentences.zh: 长期来看，这样更省钱。
sentences.hint: 长期来看 / In the long run
sentences.en: In the long run, it saves money.
sentences.why: in the long run 表示「最终、长远看」，是固定短语，run 前的 the 不能省；也可以说 in the long term。

sentences.zh: 很多人反对这项新规定。
sentences.en: Many people are against the new rule.
sentences.why: be against 后面接名词；oppose 是及物动词，不能写 oppose to。

sentences.zh: 禁令在小商店里很难执行。
sentences.en: A ban is hard to enforce in small shops.
sentences.why: enforce a ban 是固定搭配；hard to do 后面接动词原形。

sentences.zh: 我们需要一个更实际的办法。
sentences.en: We need a more practical solution.
sentences.why: practical solution 是常见搭配；solution 可数，要加 a。

sentences.zh: 如果替代品更便宜，人们就会换。
sentences.en: If alternatives are cheaper, people will switch.
sentences.why: if 引导的条件句用一般现在时，主句用 will；switch 后面可以不加宾语，表示「换掉」。
